title: Structure-Preserving Dynamic Mode Decomposition for Highly Oscillatory Dynamics of Semiclassical Schrödinger Equations
summary: We propose two novel data-driven dynamic mode decomposition (DMD)-type methods, the Crank--Nicolson DMD and the semi-implicit DMD, to predict the highly oscillatory dynamics of the semiclassical Schrödinger equations efficiently and accurately. Unlike many existing DMD-type methods which directly models the dynamics of the wave function, our approach is based on learning the Schrödinger operator while explicitly incorporating mass and energy conservation laws.
